bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo="/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$repo"
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/chat-three-topic-selector-20261114 >/dev/null
head="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
test "$head" = "5e2e8b2903eade90aa46860e09dba4be50d5c0ff" || exit 70
before="$(sha256sum scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cut -d' ' -f1)"
old="$(git show c993c89f0cba3e11980dd71c8c254812f62045c3:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
new="$(git show "$head":scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
{
 echo "USERBOT_UPGRADE_BASELINE_CHECK"
 echo "HEAD=$head"
 echo "CURRENT_EQUALS_PRIOR=$(test "$before" = "$old" && echo yes || echo no)"
 echo "NEW_EQUALS_PRIOR=$(test "$new" = "$old" && echo yes || echo no)"
 echo "CURRENT_ACTION_HEALTH=$(grep -q 'profile_button_smoke' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py && echo yes || echo no)"
 echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
} | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
